summary.short_description: This style guide offers assistance with the creation of data visualizations in line with Bosch corporate design.
summary.scope: Guidance for creating Bosch-aligned data visualization outputs, including static information graphics, dynamic information graphics, and reporting.
primary_use_cases: Select the correct visualization guidance section based on output type
Connect data visualization work with related brand topics such as colors, print, and accessibility
Find design support for review and approval of visualization drafts

categories.name: Static information graphics
categories.description: A main data visualization guidance category for static visual outputs.

categories.name: Dynamic information graphics
categories.description: A main data visualization guidance category for dynamic or interactive visual outputs.

categories.name: Reporting
categories.description: A main data visualization guidance category for reporting and dashboard/report contexts.

related.name: Colors
related.relationship: Relevant for color usage in data visualizations.

related.name: Print
related.relationship: Relevant when visualizations are used in printed materials.

related.name: Accessibility
related.relationship: Relevant for making data visualizations accessible and understandable.

ai.recommended_interpretation: Treat this page as a navigation and orientation layer for Bosch data visualization guidance rather than as a full rulebook for every chart type.
ai.when_to_use_static_information_graphics: Use for fixed information graphics where content does not change through interaction or live data updates.
ai.when_to_use_dynamic_information_graphics: Use for interactive, adaptive, or changing information graphics.
ai.when_to_use_reporting: Use for reports, dashboards, recurring business reporting, and analytical summaries.
cross_check_before_design: Check Bosch Colors guidance before assigning chart colors.
Check Accessibility guidance before relying on color-only meaning or low-contrast elements.
Check Print guidance if the visualization will be exported or printed.
Contact Design Support for review or approval when needed.

limitations: The uploaded page primarily shows the overview page, not the full detailed contents of each subpage.
Detailed rules for static graphics, dynamic graphics, and reporting may exist on linked subpages and should be extracted separately if needed.
